checkpoints.description: Task 'live-iris' completed successfully.
[1/2] Capture a 1440x900 Iris screenshot set for the home live slider. [2/2] Register the shots, cover Iris in the slider tests, verify the site suites and push.

impact_assessment.why: The home page live slider reads docs/live/shots.json and still lists only the three older apps, so Iris would be absent from the showcase even though its Live card works.
impact_assessment.benefits: Six reviewed Iris captures and a tested slider entry make the new game visible on the landing page and keep the parity check honest for every live app.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the screenshots must show the commit-named build; dependency: none beyond the existing static build; concurrency: the daily live refresh may advance Weft/Tessera but not Iris; state: docs/live/shots.json and the PNG set change together.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Capture from the deployed build directory, record its commit, validate every alt and file in tests, and run the full suites plus the strict gate before pushing.

checkpoints.description: Task 'editor-v0110' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: fix Palette 0.11.1 resize/export bounds and selection-aware auto levels, re-vendor, move Palette into the Live catalog and out of the top nav, then verify and push.

impact_assessment.why: The editor release is complete but uncommitted; analysis found an uncapped resize path and an export scale that can exceed browser canvas limits; Palette is also a top-level 'Editor' destination instead of a Live app.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prevents memory blowups and failed exports on large documents, keeps monochrome auto levels usable, and surfaces Palette where the other runnable apps live.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: live.json gains a local-build entry with its own path rule; dependency: none; concurrency: uncommitted 0.11.0 vendoring must stay intact; state: autosave/project formats unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extend sync_live_apps with a local app branch and tests, keep the Editor page reachable, re-run both suites and gates, and commit the editor release first.

checkpoints.description: Task 'editor-live-0111' completed successfully.
[1/2] Re-vendor Palette 0.11.2 and refresh its live manifest entry (version, commit, digest); [2/2] verify the site gates and push.

impact_assessment.why: Palette gained four behavioural fixes after 0.11.1 was published to the Live catalog; the vendored build and its manifest would otherwise drift from the source.

[1/2] Set Palette's public source URL in the live spec and manifest, add ADR-059, and assert the link in the profile test; [2/2] verify and push.

impact_assessment.why: Palette is now public, so its Live card can carry a Source link without changing the local-build model.
